title: Apple and Epic argue over how much Apple should get from purchases made outside the App Store
summary: Here’s Epic’s statement in reply to the filing: Apple’s filing is in, and Apple admitted that under the Ninth Circuit’s definition of “necessary costs” they would charge 0% for purchases made via linkouts to the web.
